sourceTrail: Nevada State Parks Pitchfork Ranch Water Trail
publicAccess: The official map marks Squeeze Chute, Skull Rock, Riverbend, and Last Call as water-trail access points and supplies the segment distances.

gauge.sourceFlowGuidance: 0–200 cfs not recommended; 201–500 cfs sufficient floating level; above 500 cfs recommended for experts.

safety.summary: Wear PFD; scout flow-dependent Class II/III rapids; plan around the diversion-dam take-out, cold water, strainers, limited cell service, and stop at the signed Last Call endpoint because the map marks no portage and private property beyond.

camping.summary: Riverbend and Quail Run campgrounds are documented Walker River State Recreation Area facilities; verify reservation, open-unit, fee, and access status.

gallery.description: East Walker River in Mason Valley; same-river context, not an endpoint or current-conditions photograph.

deduplication: These three scored options are longer forward access-pair combinations through the State Parks-defined access chain, not new tributaries or reversed duplicates. They intentionally overlap the adjoining Squeeze–Skull, Skull–Riverbend, and Riverbend–Last Call route cards; retain named access choices and the overlap in route summaries.
